'''Kra''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] located on the smallest continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coyn]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Kra'Tais]] or "Craftersland" was located in this city as well.
